description: This file defines an interface 'ShoppingCartCalculationService' which declares methods for calculating totals for a shopping cart in an e-commerce system. It includes method signatures for calculating the total summary with different parameter sets.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for calculating shopping cart totals.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of a shopping cart including price, subtotal, and other details, given a shopping cart, customer, store, and language.
